QuestInfo.name: [Battle Mode] Ereve in Danger
QuestInfo.0: Neinheart wants to speak with you regarding admission to the Elite Guardian Training Institute. Visit him in Ereve.
QuestInfo.1: Go see Neinheart in Ereve and find out more about the Elite Guardian Training Institute.
QuestInfo.2: You were attacked by the Black Mage's minions, but you were able to protect Ereve and the Empress thanks to the Cygnus Knights.

0.0: Surprised to hear from me? Don't be. Surprise is a weakness. I have heard that you received an Elite Guardian Training Permit from Haktorius. Come to Ereve so that I may give you orders.

yes.0: I sent you a Teleport Scroll. Use it.

no.0: When I say be here, I expect you to be here.

1.0: The Black Mage's goons attacked us, but we were able to stop the assault. Ereve is safe.

yes.0: I have reason to believe he is upon us. We have no more time for tests or games. Wait for Haktorius to send for you. I have planning to do.
